Here are the owners of the Hollywood Rangers, undefeated champions of
the American Pro Football League-Andy and Julian Smith, brothers.
They are not related to the cough-drop Smith Brothers.
Both of the Smith boys love football. Julian, who played end with the
Rangers this year, was a top-flight lineman at the University of California and
U.C.L.A., and Andy played a heap of ball in his prep school days.
Much of the success of the team this year is due to their cooperation with
the players and with Coach Bill Sargent.
